title: "The Swing Dancer Series"  Learning how to swing dance in less than 30 minutes

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains foundational swing dance moves step-by-step with a polite, encouraging tone alongside his partner. He breaks down transitions and physical positioning clearly for beginners.

lesson_structure.note: Tom and Jeri introduce themselves and the DVD purpose.
Demonstration and explanation of starting position.
Happy Day's side step closed and open.
Putting the moves together in a sequence.

cues: Step back and instead of her hand being on my shoulder
We're going to bump sides just like this
We're going to step towards each other
We're going to do a spin a little bit
safety: You want to be aware of the people around you on the dance floor.

steps_taught.name: Starting position
steps_taught.description: Lady's hand on gentleman's shoulder, gentleman's hand on lady's back, other hands clasped.

steps_taught.name: Happy Day's side step - closed & open
steps_taught.description: Stepping side to side in closed or open frame.

steps_taught.name: Side Bumps
steps_taught.description: Facing each other, stepping forward and bumping sides.

steps_taught.name: Spin Bumps
steps_taught.description: Stepping towards each other and spinning while bumping.

what_works: Clear verbal breakdown of both partners' roles and hand placements
what_hinders: Lack of counts makes rhythm tracking harder

quotes.text: The purpose of this DVD is for people with little or no dance experience.
That's why I recommend having some breathsavers before you start your dancing.
This move I like to call a bridge move.

evidence_segments.observation: The instructor stands facing the camera with his partner, holding hands and explaining the starting posture.

extraction.distinctive_method: Structuring the entire dance progression around named 'bumps' and 'bridge moves' that can transition into one another at any time.
